function.name: Restaurants_2_ReserveRestaurant

location.description: The location of the restaurant in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

function.name: Restaurants_2_FindRestaurants

price_range.description: The price category of the restaurant's offerings. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

has_seating_outdoors.description: Denotes if the restaurant has outdoor seating available. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.
